newsitem.title: UK: BFI up eight points on firmer Panamaxes.
newsitem.headline: BFI up eight points on firmer Panamaxes.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose eight points to 1,438, as brokers reported firmer conditions for April panamxes in most areas.
Frapaco fixed another 54,000 tonnes heavy grain stem U.S. Gulf/Japan with the 1981 built Evagelistra at $24.50 basis no combination ports, up 25 cents from last done.
Stronger chartering enquiry in the Pacific has resulted in reported fixtures such as the Pacific Prospect 72,800 dwt del Japan mid-March for three to five months at $12,300 daily.
Grain chartering from the Plate continues to be active and rates are firmer for handy sizes in particulary.
Andre covered 23,000 tonnes corn ppt Plate/Malaysia at $41.
At 1315 GMT the BIFFEX futures had traded just two lots on April at 1,605, up four points from Friday.
